company.name: SUPERBLOCK
company.shortDescription: Revolutionizing Real-World Asset Tokenization | Bridging Traditional Finance and DeFi
company.description:
SUPERBLOCK is a cutting-edge RWA (Real-World Asset) Tokenization Ecosystem designed to bridge traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). By leveraging blockchain technology and advanced AI, we empower investors, institutions, and entrepreneurs to tokenize, manage, and trade real-world assets securely and efficiently.  
Our mission is to democratize access to high-value real-world assets, offering innovative solutions for seamless financial transformation. The company focuses on democratizing access to alternative investments while improving liquidity, transparency, and efficiency within modern financial ecosystems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $300,000, or 60% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,116,202 to $4,262,597, a 2.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
